verses: Aur jab sitaray jhar jayen gay
Aur jab samandar beh niklen gay
Aur jab qabreen (shaq ker kay) ukhar di jayen gi
(uss waqt) her shakhs apney aagay bhejay huye aur peechay choray huye (yani aglay pichlay aemaal) ko maloom ker ley ga
Aey insan! tujhay apney rab karim say kiss cheez ney behkaya
Jiss (rab ney) tujhay peda kiya, phir theek thaak kiya, phir (durust aur) barabar banaya
Jiss soorat mein chaha tujhay jor diya
Hergiz nahi balkay)yeh tum to jaza o saza kay din ko jhutlatay ho
Yaqeenan tum per nigehbaan izzat walay
Kuch tum kertay ho woh jantay hain
Yaqeenan nek log (jannat kay aish o aaram aur) nematon mein hun gay
Aur yaqeenan badkaar log dozakh mein hun gay
Badlay walay din uss mein jayen gay
Woh uss say kabhi ghaeeb na honey payen gay
Tujhay kuch khabar bhi hai kay badlay ka din kiya hai
Mein phir (kehta hun kay) tujhay kiya maloom kay jaza (aur saza) ka din kiya hai
(woh hai) jiss din koi shakhs kissi shakhs kay liye kissi cheez ka mukhtar na hoga, aur (tamam tar) ehkaam uss roz Allah kay hi hun gay
